title: Legora extends offering with legal intake in Microsoft Teams and agentic search across Microsoft 365
summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, announced an expansion of its Microsoft 365 capabilities, adding legal intake in Microsoft Teams and agentic search across Microsoft 365 enterprise data.
body_markdown:
Legal teams can act on requests with Microsoft 365 context and Legora’s legal intelligence, while keeping existing user permissions intact throughout.


Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, today announced an expansion of its Microsoft 365 capabilities, adding legal intake in Microsoft Teams and agentic search across Microsoft 365 enterprise data. The two new offerings are added to existing Microsoft SharePoint and OneDrive integrations and its MCP-powered Copilot plug-in. Together, they connect Legora with the Microsoft 365 applications legal teams already use: for example, a request can begin in Microsoft Teams, relevant emails, meetings, and document context can inform the legal work through Legora’s legal intelligence, and lawyers can check the underlying sources and continue their work in Microsoft Word.


Everyday legal requests arrive through chat, email, and meetings, while the supporting context sits in Microsoft 365 inboxes, calendars, and SharePoint document libraries. For lawyers at law firms and in-house teams, gathering that context can mean re-entering requests, forwarding attachments, and exporting files into separate tools. These extra steps can slow down the work and create document copies outside the original permission controls. By connecting requests, Microsoft 365 context, and Legora’s legal intelligence, the new capabilities help lawyers act on legal questions with all the supporting information right in front of them.


“Legal work is shifting from executing tasks to directing them and standing behind the results. That only holds up if requests arrive with context and stay inside the controls legal teams already trust,” said **Max Junestrand, CEO and co-founder of Legora** . “With Microsoft, we’re making that possible, so legal professionals can spend more of their time on the judgment their stakeholders depend on them for.”


**From legal request to review-ready work**


Four new features bring Microsoft 365 context and Legora’s legal capabilities together, giving legal teams multiple ways to engage with legal work while staying connected to the Microsoft 365 tools and experiences they already use:


-


**Submit a legal request from Microsoft Teams** . Legal intake in Microsoft Teams (new, generally available) - lets users mention “@Legora” to submit a request to the legal team, connecting the request with Legora’s legal capabilities.


-


**Turn email threads into action items with Microsoft 365 and Legora** . Agentic search across Microsoft Outlook and Calendar (new, generally available) - legal teams can leverage relevant email and calendar context from Microsoft 365 to find the information behind a task, support drafting a response, and prepare appropriate follow-up actions. The lawyer remains in control throughout.


-


**Review agreements alongside policies and precedents** . Microsoft SharePoint (in beta) - the Legora Agent can draw on stored documents in Microsoft SharePoint to support agreement review and save edits back to SharePoint as a new version.


-


**Bring Legora’s legal intelligence into Microsoft Copilot** . The Legora plugin in Copilot for Legal (generally available) - lets users initiate legal work from Microsoft 365 Copilot and access Legora’s legal capabilities as part of the interaction.


Bringing Microsoft 365 context together with Legora’s legal intelligence helps legal teams spend less time gathering material and more time reviewing the work.


"Ensuring that our use of AI enhances the quality that Linklaters' clients expect is central to our strategy,” said **Tom Quoroll, Partner at Linklaters** . “Legora's integration with the wealth of Microsoft 365 context transforms our lawyers' ability to leverage that data. We're excited to connect two of the most powerful tools in our technology stack."


“Legora is a great example of the bold AI innovation changing how legal work gets done, and at Microsoft, we are proud to help bring its solutions to lawyers around the world,” said **Samer Abu-Ltaif, President, Microsoft EMEA** . “Our customers want AI that works where they already work. Legora helps legal teams move from intake to finished work with relevant organizational context, ensuring enterprise security and governance. It’s a clear example of how Microsoft’s partner ecosystem turns AI into real impact.”


To learn more, visit our[blog](https://legora.com/blog/bringing-the-power-of-legora-across-microsoft-365#top) or find Legora on[Microsoft Marketplace](https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/leyaab.legora) .


Legora will be at Microsoft Ignite from November 17-20, 2026 in San Francisco, exhibiting at booth #1726.


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 140,000 legal professionals at more than 2,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.
